p.title: Data Scientist | AIML Engineer
p.summary: ML / GenAI fresher with hands-on experience building end-to-end ML and NLP projects: classical ML model benchmarking, recommendation systems, and a RAG-based LLM chatbot (LangChain, FAISS, Llama 3.3 via Groq), with 2 apps deployed on Streamlit Cloud. Completed B.E. Computer Science (2025) while working in AI/CV data quality and validation at Mahendra Next Wealth IT India Pvt Ltd, including 1 live production project. Certified in Data Science by IIT Madras Research Park (GUVI). Seeking a junior ML / Data Science role. Open to relocating to Pune.
p.skills: Python, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, SQL, Statistics & Probability, Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, PyTorch, Deep Learning, LLM, RAG, Data Visualization, Power BI, Matplotlib/Seaborn, Git/GitHub, Streamlit

edu.deg: IIT-M Advanced Programming Professional & Master Data Science

exp.co: MahendraNext Wealth IT India Pvt Ltd (Night Shift, concurrent with full-time education)
exp.pts:
Delivered 2 successful Computer Vision POC projects and managed annotation quality for 1 live AI/CV production project, ensuring dataset accuracy for model training pipelines
Coordinated cross-shift workflows and quality checks for ML training data annotation, supporting model accuracy and dataset readiness for AI/ML pipelines

intern.pts:
Cleaned and analyzed an 8,000-row sales dataset, performing exploratory data analysis and data visualization in Jupyter notebooks and Excel
Built sales prediction and customer segmentation models on the cleaned dataset

proj.name: Telecom AI Copilot (RAG-based Chatbot)
proj.tech: RAG, LangChain, FAISS, HuggingFace, DistilBERT, RoBERTa, LLM (Groq), Semantic Search
proj.pts:
Developed a telecom AI assistant using LangChain-based RAG architecture, processing 19,995 records across policy/pricing documents for grounded customer support responses
Fine-tuned DistilBERT for intent classification and RoBERTa for sentiment analysis to route and prioritize customer queries, achieving 100% intent accuracy
Implemented semantic retrieval using HuggingFace all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model, converting queries into 384-dimensional vector embeddings, integrated with FAISS for sub-second retrieval (<1s)
Designed an evaluation pipeline achieving 90%+ retrieval accuracy, generating responses using Llama 3.3 70B via Groq API
Benchmarked cloud-hosted (Llama 3.3 70B via Groq) against self-hosted open-source models (Ollama) on response latency and quality; documented model evaluation results and architecture decisions as project knowledge base

proj.name: IMDb Movie Recommendation System (NLP)
proj.tech: Python, Selenium, NLP, TF-IDF, Cosine Similarity
proj.pts:
Built a movie recommendation system by scraping and analyzing 300+ IMDb 2024 movies using Selenium, extracting storyline data for content-based filtering
Applied TF-IDF vectorization and Cosine Similarity on movie storylines to recommend similar movies, achieving relevant matches for 85%+ of test queries
Developed and deployed an interactive Streamlit Cloud app, returning top-5 similar movie recommendations in real-time (<2s response)

proj.name: Swiggy Restaurant Recommendation System
proj.pts:
Built a personalized restaurant recommendation system using One-Hot Encoding and K-Means/Cosine Similarity; processed 20,000 restaurant records and optimized to a top-10 city subset to balance model performance with computational efficiency
Deployed an interactive Streamlit dashboard on Streamlit Cloud, delivering real-time recommendations in under 2 seconds
Identified and resolved high-dimensionality issues from One-Hot Encoding on large categorical data by strategic feature scoping, improving training speed without accuracy loss

cert.name: Advanced Professional Certification in Data Science (Grade A)
